description: This file provides support for integrating Snowflake's REST API with a language model interface, including transformations between Snowflake's specific content format and OpenAI compatible formats, as well as handling responses and request constructions in a custom Snowflake-specific manner.

classes.name: SnowflakeConfig
classes.description: Configuration class that handles transformations and request/response flow for Snowflake's REST API, including format conversions and API URL generation.

methods.name: get_config(cls)
methods.description: Returns configuration data by calling superclass method.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Optional[List[ChatCompletionMessageToolCall]]] _transform_tool_calls_from_snowflake_to_openai( self, content_list: List[Dict[str, Any]] )
methods.description: Transforms Snowflake-specific content list with tool calls into plain text and OpenAI formatted tool call objects.

methods.name: ModelResponse transform_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, model_response: ModelResponse, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, request_data: dict, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, encoding: Any, api_key: Optional[str] = None, json_mode: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Transforms the raw Snowflake API response into an OpenAI-compatible ModelResponse, updating content and tool calls accordingly.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, stream: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs the API URL for completing requests, defaulting to Snowflake's cortex inference endpoint.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] _transform_tools(self, tools: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Converts a list of tools from OpenAI format to Snowflake-specific tool_spec format.

methods.name: Union[str,Dict[str,Any]] _transform_tool_choice( self, tool_choice: Union[str, Dict[str, Any]] )
methods.description: Transforms tool choice format between OpenAI and Snowflake conventions.

methods.name: dict transform_request( self, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Prepares the request payload by transforming tools and tool choices from OpenAI format to Snowflake format.
